ethiopia.item2_desc: Optimized delivery for Ethiopian mobile numbers across Addis Ababa and regional zones with real-time delivery status.

ethiopia.item6_desc: Culturally dignified copy, sober charcoal/silver palettes, and ceremonial Ethiopian crosses for memorial and Tazkar events.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about designing, sending, and scanning with Teri.
faq.a1: A card is a personalized invitation sent to one guest or family. It includes their custom invitation card, personal RSVP link, directions, and single-use door QR pass.
faq.q2: Do guests need to install an app?
faq.a2: No app required. Guests receive a standard SMS or email with a fast-loading link that opens directly in any mobile web browser. Door staff also scan directly through their web browser.
faq.q3: What if a guest loses their QR code?
faq.a3: The host can look up any guest by name or phone number on the live door dashboard and check them in manually with one tap.
faq.q4: Can I use my own design or upload photos?
faq.a4: Yes. You can start from any of our 84 curated Ethiopian templates or upload your own background image, portrait photos, and custom wording in the editor.
faq.a5: Yes. Your guest contact information and phone numbers are encrypted, never sold, and only used to deliver your event's invitations and reminders.
faq.a6: We accept Telebirr, CBE Birr, Ethiopian bank transfers, and international credit/debit cards for diaspora hosts.
